About

A natural explorer looking to build in multiple industries.

As a freelance web designer, I build custom websites for small businesses, entrepreneurs, and professionals. This work draws on the technical skills I learned through my college corse work and client-facing experience I developed as Business Development Manager for the Amusement Division at Safe-Strap Company.

I am currently participating in the Disney College Program, deepening my foundation in hospitality and operational excellence through professional classes and my guest facing role as Conceriege at Disney's Saratoga Springs

In addition to my day-to-day, I am a founder in the early stages developing Thrift, a sustainability-focused app designed to change how people think about consumption.

Whether that is an app, a client website, or a career from scratch, I am drawn to the process of taking something from idea to reality.
